gloss: to involve danger; to be fraught with risk

definitions.gloss: to involve danger; to be fraught with risk; to carry risk within
definitions.explanation: To contain inherent danger or risk within something. The verb 孕む literally means 'to be pregnant with,' giving the sense that danger lurks within and may emerge. Used in formal or written contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{危険|きけん}を{孕|はら}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{孕|はら}んでいる→孕む：12295_haramu⟧。
examples.english: New technology carries great potential along with inherent risks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安易|あんい}→安易：03997_ani⟧な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{危険|きけん}を{孕|はら}むこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Hasty decisions can be fraught with great danger.

notes:
USAGE:
The verb ⟦{孕|はら}む→孕む：12295_haramu⟧ literally means "to be pregnant" or "to conceive," giving this expression a vivid metaphorical force — danger is "gestating" within the situation. It implies hidden, latent risk rather than obvious danger. Common in news, essays, and formal writing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{孕|はら}む→孕む：12295_haramu⟧ pattern is used with other abstract nouns: ⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{孕|はら}む→孕む：12295_haramu⟧ (to contain contradictions), ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{孕|はら}む→孕む：12295_haramu⟧ (to involve problems).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {危険|きけん}を{孕|はら}んだ⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧ (a situation fraught with danger)
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{危険|きけん}を{孕|はら}む (to carry great risk)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伴|ともな}う→伴う：10389_tomonau⟧: to be accompanied by danger — similar but less literary
- ⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have risk — straightforward and neutral
- ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はらんで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: same expression in て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form — most common usage
